text:
maya (PM): Kicking off thread for the Quantized Advisor + eval-triggered fallback launch. Need clear launch gates + owners. Customers want auto-recs + safe rollback. Propose three gates: infra readiness, quality SLO, ops/runbook.

jake (Eng): Agree. Runtime needs quantization-aware kernels + a hot-fallback path. ETA ~3 sprints for infra work. Current blockers: model variant routing and cache invalidation.

priya (ML): For eval signals I'd recommend: concordance drop >= 3% vs baseline OR hallucination F1 drop. We'll need an eval harness + per-customer synthetic prompt sets.

sam (Solutions): AcmeHealth asked for per-tenant guardrails and an "explain why" snippet for each recommendation. Add a concise `reason` field in API responses, e.g. `reason: \"latency vs quality tradeoff\"`.

tom (SRE): SRE asks we define SLOs: p95 latency <= 300ms on Dedicated; error rate < 0.5%. Require automated canary rollback if fallback triggers for >5% of requests over 10m.

eliza (ProductOps): Draft ops checklist (short): canary cohort 5%, rollback playbook, opt-in flow, audit logs retention 90d. I'll own rollout notes.

maya (PM): Concrete acceptance criteria (draft):
```
- Infra: quant kernels in runtime, model-variant routing + transparent cache invalidation tested
- Quality: eval harness + baseline concordance numbers for models A/B/C
- Observability: eval-triggered alerts, per-tenant metrics, audit logs for rollbacks
- API UX: `eval_threshold` configurable, `reason` field in responses, sample curl/SDK snippet
- Ops: 5% canary, automated rollback on >=5% fallback rate in 10m, runbook + playbook written
- Docs & SE: runbook + migration guide + three example customer configs
```

jake (Eng): :thumbsup: I'll add perf test numbers and a perf script by EOD Friday; will note regressions if quantized path > baseline latency +15%.

priya (ML): I'll build the eval harness and produce baseline concordance. Quick Q: initial concordance threshold? 95%?

maya (PM): Let's start with 94% concordance as default but make it per-customer configurable. Document as `eval_threshold`.

sam (Solutions): Migration/opt-in plan: UI toggle + API flag. Need sample curl for SEs. Eg: `curl -X POST /v1/launch -d '{"quant_advisor":true, "eval_threshold":0.94}'`

eliza (ProductOps): I'll prepare customer comms and schedule a 30m huddle tomorrow to sync owners. :calendar: 

jake (Eng): Tomorrow works. Note to infra: create canary plan template.

deploy-bot: Created canary plan template at /infra/canary-plans/quant-advisor.json

maya (PM): Thanks all — action items: Jake: perf tests + infra plan; Priya: eval harness + baselines; Tom: automation for rollback; Eliza: comms + runbook; Sam: SE sample scripts. I'll collate acceptance criteria into the PR. :raised_hands:
